UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Official workspace profile for a registered NIRVANA user (PII-free).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: Official full name displayed in the workspace.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII record containing the official's verified email address.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

email.description: Verified email address of the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the PII record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the PII record was last updated.

grantedBy.description: UID of the admin who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

AuditLog.title: AuditLog
AuditLog.description: Immutable system activity audit log entry recording user, role, action taken, details, and server timestamp.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the acting user.

userName.description: Display name of the official who performed the action (PII-free).

role.description: Role of the user when the action was performed.

action.description: System action identifier (e.g. LOGIN, LOGOUT, VIEW_PROJECT, EXPORT_REPORT, UPLOAD_DATA, CHANGE_USER_ROLE).

details.description: Human-readable description of the action taken.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp when the audit log entry was recorded.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores workspace profiles for registered NIRVANA officials.

/users/{userId}/private/{infoId}.description: Stores isolated PII (email) for the user under the Split Collection strategy.

/audit_logs/{logId}.description: Stores immutable system audit log records queried by the Administrator AuditLogTable.
